test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Five friends A, B, G, R and T are arranged in a row facing north but not necessarily in the same order. B sits at left end of the row. Only two people are sitting between A and G. A sits immediate next to the B and R sits second to the right of B. Who sits between R and G?
solution:
**Given : **Five friends A, B, G, R and T are arranged in a row facing north.

**Explanation :**

1) B sits at left end of the row.

2) A sits immediate next to the B and R sits second to the right of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/373736a9ef37244c28c0dac0a6a68fcded7cfc70ad6ef084389fd038064e63e2.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5df6570279641641ae35f516eba77c7a16f1f34749e333cd2175f0b5f87b953a.png] 

3) Only two people are sitting between A and G.

After positing G only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b16e8a73aaa1b8e41dcfab6f061cd98228a1e80bdee39063372305f88c6b5ce.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a46365af249432bfc4111500d017d9d10622366278bf6d45eac3f2cd6658b45.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement T sits between R and G.

Hence, **"T"** is the correct answer.
